quality_check.description: A single vertical style-reference sheet showing a warm earthen stone slab with pitted limestone samples, ochre and sienna pigment brush tests, dark primitive geometric marks, marbled rock texture, loose pigment wells, brushes, and a labeled palette across the top. The lighting is warm and softly shadowed, with a strongly tactile carved-stone presentation.

The central dark motif is relatively crisp, geometric, and stencil-like compared with the more irregular expressive primitive silhouette language of the operator style reference.
The candidate appears closer to a 2:3 vertical proportion than the requested exact 9:16 aspect ratio.

prompt: Create exactly one 9:16 vertical style reference sheet — a texture and palette sample, not a scene. Medium: fresco. Texture family: weathered cave rock and pitted limestone grain. Palette: limestone cream, warm raw ochre, burnt sienna, deep umber, soot charcoal black, and muted terracotta red. Line treatment: expressive primitive silhouettes and abraded brush contours reminiscent of prehistoric rock wall pigment. Lighting: subtle warm ambient firelight glow across raw earthen stone with soft diffused shadows. Avoid: no photorealism, no 3D CGI, no slick vector art, no modern synthetic neon colors, no digital lens flare, no modern clothing. No characters, no text, no logos, no photorealism. The attached operator_style_reference is style-only: use its palette, material texture, line language and lighting as inspiration for this original neutral anchor. Do not copy its subject, composition, text, logo, person, or recognizable layout.
